0.00201: The benchmark no longer asks to run after room 10 (it may come back for testers later)
0.00200: Art Lab: the Vampire Lord's card is twice as wide here too, as in the game since 0.196
0.00199: Fixed: a heavy blow could print its damage with a fraction (-358.79999) since the 2.3x multiplier — damage is always a whole number again
0.00198: Heavy Attack: its cooldown now counts the ordinary turns between heavies (the heavy's own turn used to count, so a cooldown of 3 was back after two blows and two Quicken boons made it every turn); a heavy blow does 2.3x damage, up from 2x, to make up for it in part
0.00197: Build numbers now read 0.00197 (five decimals), inside and out
A new build reaches you within about two minutes of its release: the game checks every minute and never reads a stale copy

Smoother fights: the background holds 60 fps while a blow plays instead of running at the screen's full rate, the card glow no longer stalls the GPU, the pulsing buttons no longer repaint every frame, and a 40 Hz screen no longer loses the 3D background

Fixed: the narrator could say two lines in the wrong order; muted music kept playing silently; a dialog swallowed F5 and F12; a malformed save code broke the Great Hall; the changelist could miss the newest build; a chest could pay out twice
Under the hood: a review of the whole project — tuning moved into the data files, the ladder's and the lights' numbers too, dead code and stale comments out, a one-command release tool
0.00196: Bosses loom larger: the boss's card is twice as wide, and still fits the row with all its summoned minions
0.00195: The cards' plates are see-through again with the glow on them, as in the Card Lab; the glow a little stronger
0.00194: Art Lab: nine portraits approved (the knight, rat, skeleton, Cinderborn, Cult Acolyte, wraith, Crypt Spider, Hollow Hound, Blood Knight); their other candidates pruned. Not in the game yet: four characters remain
0.00193: Art Lab: five new Cave Shrieker candidates drawn from the painting with a hint against the rodent look (its style reference no longer borrows the rat's sheet); the Shrieker's portrait file is cave_shrieker.webp
0.00192: Art Lab: candidates for the other ten characters (four each from the style sheets; the Shrieker, Fellblade, gargoyle and Hollow Hound also two from the ossuary painting); the knight's and the rat's picks recorded
0.00191: Art Lab: the pilot redrawn once more from the owner's seven style sheets (assets/style/), which the generator now uses as the style reference — twelve new candidates for the knight, the rat and the Vampire Lord
0.00190: Art Lab: the cut-out clears enclosed patches of background anywhere in the picture (the loop between an arm and the sword), not only under the figure
0.00189: The labs load the game's modules and their own script under the build number, so a lab never runs the previous build's files after a deploy; an error in a lab is written onto the page
0.00188: The Old Wizard has five more things to say about an OVERKILL, so he repeats himself less on a long run
